description: List entity refs matching a glob — e.g. `plugin::billing.*` for a plugin's whole surface, `api::*` for all APIs, `*` for everything. Only `*` is special. Each result carries the kinds it resolves to.

from.description: A path inside the target project (e.g. the file you are editing). Disambiguates a multi-project workspace.

project.description: A project name (its folder) or root path. Use when you have no file path in hand.

name: list_refs
title: List refs by glob
